step_a: Detect binary defects on the original input, remove stray blue and construct every orange eight-neighbor rim.
intermediate: The four-connected orange components of the constructed rim field, with their cell counts and row-major origins.
step_b: Keep only the largest orange component, restoring all other orange cells to the cleaned binary input; ties choose the row-major first component.
why_b_depends_on_a: Rims around disconnected black defects can join into a single component. Their painted cell counts and connectivity do not equal the original black-component sizes. Selecting the largest defect before painting changes the retained rim.
